title: Apply for registration under the automotive workshop scheme (RAWS)
summary: Find out what you need and how to apply to register a used vehicle that was imported into Australia under the registered automotive workshop scheme (RAWS).
intro: If you want to register a used vehicle that has been imported into Australia under the registered automotive workshop scheme (RAWS), you'll need to visit a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: You are registering a used vehicle that has been imported into Australia under the registered automotive workshop scheme (RAWS).
what_you_need: Compulsory third party (CTP) insurance receipt (green slip) with the number plate section left blank (except for trailers)
Authorised Unregistered Vehicle Inspection Scheme (AUVIS) report (blue slip)
Vehicle Compliance Certificate from a licensed certifier (if the vehicle has been modified)

how_to_steps.text: Take the completed form and required documents to a service centre and lodge your application.

internal_links.text: Vehicle Compliance Certificate from a licensed certifier
Apply to register a personally imported vehicle

faqs.q: Where do I apply to register my imported vehicle?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to lodge your application.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to register my imported vehicle?
faqs.a: You need proof of identity, proof of registration entitlement, your proof of concession (if applicable), a CTP insurance receipt (green slip), an AUVIS report (blue slip), and a Vehicle Compliance Certificate if the vehicle was modified.

faqs.q: What forms do I need for the application?
faqs.a: You need the PDF form, 'Application for Registration', and your fee payment.
